Author: monkdim
Name: BossMod Rewired
Description:
A fork of BossMod Reborn focused on depth: role-specific positioning, exact safe spots, mechanic timer bars and per-mechanic notes for savage and ultimate content.

Built on the work of awgil's ffxiv_bossmod and the Combat Reborn team's BossMod Reborn, both BSD 3-Clause.
Punchline: Boss mechanics, with the positions spelled out
